title: The Shadow Price of Intelligence: Quality Degradation in LLM Inference as a Supply Chain Problem
abstract: arXiv:2608.23986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model providers are compute constrained, and their universal response to congestion is to degrade service: route queries to smaller models, cut reasoning effort, truncate context. The industry's accounting says this saves money. We show the accounting is wrong, because it prices a query when the customer buys an answer. A degraded answer fails with some probability, and a failed answer either returns as a retry, inflating arrivals when the system is most loaded, or departs as churn, destroying lifetime value on a ledger no cost dashboard displays. We model inference allocation with three classical primitives: a newsvendor whose stockout cost is churned lifetime value, a geometric retry multiplier in which the recycled product is dissatisfaction, and a two-regime transient queue whose arrival rate is made endogenous by retries. translated_title: 智能的隐性成本：大语言模型推理中的质量退化作为供应链问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23986v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型提供商受计算资源约束，其对拥塞的普遍反应是降低服务质量：将查询路由至较小模型、减少推理努力、截断上下文。行业会计认为这能节省成本。我们证明这种会计核算是错误的，因为它按客户购买答案时定价查询。退化的答案有一定概率失败，而失败的答案要么作为重试返回，在系统负载最高时增加到达量，要么作为流失离开，在无成本仪表板显示的账本上摧毁终身价值。我们用三个经典原语建模推理分配：一个报童模型，其缺货成本为流失的终身价值；一个几何重试乘数，其中回收产品是不满意度；一个两状态瞬态队列，其到达率因重试而内生。静态上，存在一个非空、可测的区间，其中更便宜的模型每单位节省能源。
tldr: 论文揭示大语言模型推理中质量退化被错误核算为成本节约，实际通过重试和客户流失造成更大经济损失，并提出供应链视角的建模框架。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that quality degradation in LLM inference is incorrectly accounted as cost savings, actually causing greater economic losses through retries and customer churn, and proposes a supply chain perspective modeling framework.
